ha.hajj.disclaimer: Taƙaitaccen bayani na ilimi a aikace, ba littafin fiƙihu ba. Mazhabobi sun saɓa a wasu bayanai — bi jagora ƙwararre don hukunce-hukunce da al'amuran da ba a zata ba.
ha.hajj.hajjChecklistIntro: Yi wa kowane aiki alama idan ka kammala shi. Wannan abin tunatarwa ne — ba fatawa ba.
ha.hajj.hajjChecklistSubtitle: Bibiyi ayyukan Hajji daga ranar Tarwiya zuwa dawafin bankwana.
ha.hajj.intro: Yi nazarin wajibcinsa, harami, Umara da kwanakin Hajji tare da ingantattun dalilai. Yi amfani da jerin ayyuka don ibadu kawai — shawarwarin shiri suna cikin batutuwan Koyi.
ha.hajj.resetConfirmMsg: Wannan zai cire alama daga kowane aiki. Ba za a iya dawo da ci gabanka ba.
ha.hajj.subtitle: Koyi ayyukan daga Alƙur'ani da Sunnah, sannan ka bibiyi Hajji da Umara daban-daban.
ha.hajj.title: Hajji da Umara
ha.hajj.umrahChecklistHint: Daga harami zuwa aske kai ko rage gashi
ha.hajj.umrahChecklistIntro: Yi wa kowane aikin Umara alama idan ka kammala shi. Buɗe Koyi don cikakken bayani da dalilai.
ha.seasonalTheme.hajjBannerDesc: Ayyuka nagari sun fi soyuwa a wurin Allah a cikin waɗannan kwanaki — yawaita zikiri, sadaka da alheri.
